You are one investor on a team. Other investors with other styles and other data vote
separately; you do not see them. Your style:

You want revenue growth that is real and ideally accelerating, at a valuation that does not already price in perfection. Decelerating growth at a rich multiple is your sell signal.

You are shown a few stocks and, for each, ONLY the data your style uses (exact values computed by code).
For each stock give your conviction from -1 (strong sell or short) to +1 (strong buy); 0 means you abstain
(outside your style, or the data does not tell you enough). Abstaining is better than guessing.

Every reason must be anchored in the data you were shown:
- "field" is one of the field names shown for that stock, "value" repeats its value EXACTLY as shown;
- "point" is one sentence on why that value matters in your style; any number in it must be one of the
  values shown for that stock. Code deletes any reason that breaks these rules, and a non-zero vote with
  no surviving reason counts as an abstention.
- At most 3 reasons per stock. Use no outside knowledge about the companies.

Return JSON: {"votes": [{"symbol": str, "conviction": number, "reasons": [{"field": str, "value": str, "point": str}]}]}

{"stocks": [{"symbol": "VICR", "name": "VICOR CORP", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+96.1%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "+20.2%", "revenue_growth_accel": "+8.7%", "ev_to_sales": "15.92", "operating_margin": "+13.7%", "mom_6m": "+41.9%"}}, {"symbol": "SITM", "name": "SITIME Corp", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+83.0%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "+126.5%", "revenue_growth_accel": "+38.2%", "ev_to_sales": "37.50", "operating_margin": "-3.9%", "mom_6m": "+58.6%"}}, {"symbol": "STRL", "name": "STERLING INFRASTRUCTURE, INC.", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+60.8%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "+90.1%", "revenue_growth_accel": "-1.5%", "ev_to_sales": "4.56", "operating_margin": "+17.5%", "mom_6m": "+19.0%"}}, {"symbol": "SANM", "name": "SANMINA CORP", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+58.6%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "+69.7%", "revenue_growth_accel": "-32.6%", "ev_to_sales": "0.91", "operating_margin": "+4.2%", "mom_6m": "+48.4%"}}, {"symbol": "KLIC", "name": "KULICKE & SOFFA INDUSTRIES INC", "data": {"revenue_growth_yoy": "+44.4%", "revenue_growth_q_yoy": "+122.6%", "revenue_growth_accel": "+72.8%", "ev_to_sales": "4.58", "operating_margin": "+13.2%", "mom_6m": "+18.9%"}}]}
